changelog: Settings entry: an always-on observer now watches the settings screen and places the CS3M entry independently of the master switch, the fragment callbacks and the navigation listener - whichever of them the host breaks, the entry still gets placed and removed correctly.
Settings entry: resolution accepts the settings screen through the Compose screen itself, so it no longer depends on seeing the host fragment.
The gear sheet reports the placement outcome right after saving 'Show in Settings', so a missing entry can be diagnosed in seconds instead of log files.
